eyesStart.summary: Queues OLED initialization for an explicit controller, height and address.
eyesStart.returns: Command; poll eyes ready and inspect status.
prerequisites: Import Robot Eyes and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. start eyes OLED: menu.eyesController; library example SSD1306.
2. height: number; library example 64.
3. address: number; library example 60.

examples.title: Use start eyes OLED … height … address …
examples.explanation: Block notation: Queues OLED initialization for an explicit controller, height and address. Command; poll eyes ready and inspect status.

notes: Native RoboEyes on I2C0 SDA7/SCL8. Requires matching P4 firmware. The 128x64 SSD1306 profile at 0x3C was aligned and confirmed visible by the user; controller silicon ID remains unknown. Select the controller explicitly. Start queues initialization; ready is true after the first complete I2C frame, not proof of visible eyes. Coordinates 0..1000: left/top=0, center=500. Moods default/tired/angry/happy. Stop All stops animations and retains the last frame. Advanced try reporters return false for invalid settings or a full animation queue. Real RoboEyes is GPL-3.0-or-later; no ArduinoCore required.
Source: boards\waveshare_esp32p4_wifi6\integration\Robot_Eyes.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
